preload and afterload\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPreload :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPreload is volume of blood received by the heart. Basically preload is stretch.It is the ventricular stretch at the end of diastole. Occurrence : during diastole Depends on : The amount of ventricular filling. Preload is a volume. Affecting factors : venous blood pressure and the rate of\u0026nbsp; venous return.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfterload :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Afterload is the pressure that the Chambers of the heart must generate in order to eject blood out of heart. Occurrence : during systole Depends on :The arterial blood pressure and vascular tone. Afterload is a pressure. font-family: georgia;\"\u003EThis is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EA 60 year old female resident of suryapet farmer by occupation came to the OPD with\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #fcff01; color: red; font-family: georgia;\"\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003ESwelling of both legs\u0026nbsp; since 20 days\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EBreathlessness since 2 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #f4cccc; color: #ff00fe; font-family: georgia;\"\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 3 years ago when she developed lower back pain which was sudden in onset gradually progressive no aggravating and relieving factors and she noticed decreased urine output that is\u0026nbsp; not associated with frequency, urgency, burning micturition\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EThere is\u0026nbsp; bilateral pedal edema\u0026nbsp; which was insidious in onset gradually progressive intially extending upto ankle then progressed to knee which was of grade 3\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EShe has shortness of breath which was sudden in onset\u0026nbsp; gradually progressive grade 3 aggravated on walking relevied by taking rest\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EThen she was taken to hospital where they diagnosed as kidney failure and was on medication for 6 months then started on dialysis twice a week\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EYesterday she was brought to the hospital due to severe shortness of breath grade 4 aggravated on lying down position and slightly relieved on sitting\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EPresently Pedal edema in both legs extending upto the knee. She was having tremors of\u0026nbsp; both hands and legs which are occurring infrequently\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003Ehistory of orthopnea present\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003ENo history of evening rise of temperature\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003ENo history of abdominal pain\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #fcff01; color: #800180;\"\u003EPAST HISTORY : \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003Eknown case of hypertension since 1year\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003ENot a known case of diabetes asthma epilepsy tuberculosis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #ffa400; color: #cc0000;\"\u003ETREATMENT HISTORY :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E On regular dialysis\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EShe is on medication nifedipine and furosemide\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #01ffff; color: red;\"\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #cc0000;\"\u003EBefore illness :\u0026nbsp; \u003C\/span\u003Emixed diet, normal appetite, adequate sleep, regular bowel and bladder moments no addictions and allergies\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #04ff00;\"\u003EAfter illness :\u003C\/span\u003E Diet : consuming foods like\u0026nbsp; idly milk in small quantities reduced appetite, reduced bowel and bladder\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #ffd966; color: red;\"\u003EDAILY ROUTINE :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180; font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EBEFORE ILLNESS :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003Ewakes up at 6 am does house hold work like cooking, washing utensils till 8:30am then she eats rice with pickle or curry as breakfast and then goes to field. Eats lunch at 1:00 pm and then comes back home at5:00 pm does house\u0026nbsp; hold work and drinks a cup of tea. Dinner at 8:30 pm and goes back to sleep at 10:00pm\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #2b00fe;\"\u003EAFTER ILLNESS:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #2b00fe;\"\u003E\u003C\/span\u003Estopped working 2 years back from then she just stays at home\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #01ffff; color: #ffa400;\"\u003EFAMILY HISTORY :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E not significant\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #ffd966; color: red;\"\u003EGeneral examination :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003Epatient was conscious coherent cooperative thin built moderately nourished\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EPallor present.
